description:
Declare Wizards of Thay as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to each Wizards of Thay.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.
